Fair point. Checking: the GenAI semantic conventions say nothing about audio output or transcripts; their output-message schema has a `BlobPart` with a `modality`, which is what `input_audio` already maps to on the input side here. `opentelemetry-instrumentation-openai-v2` and OpenInference's OpenAI instrumentation record neither the audio nor the transcript of `message.audio`, only the audio token counts. The audio itself is available: `message.audio.data` carries it base64-encoded (streamed in pieces that `ChatCompletionStreamState` concatenates), and `transcript` is its text.

2538a4d left the bytes out to keep spans small and recorded only the transcript as a text part. d0075bd now records the audio as a `BlobPart(modality='audio')`, like `input_audio`, with the transcript as a text part next to it. The response doesn't carry the format (it's a request parameter), so no media type is set. If you'd rather keep spans small and record only the transcript, reverting d0075bd gives that.
it should faithfully represent the actual message parts, not make up text parts

Agreed, the transcript isn't a part of the message, so I shouldn't have turned it into a text part. e2116bf removes it: an audio response is now recorded as just the audio, a `BlobPart(modality='audio')` like `input_audio`, and nothing is added for the transcript. The two audio tests (a `ChatCompletionMessage` and a streamed one) now expect only that blob part. This also means the PR no longer records the transcript, so I'll update the title and description to match. (Drafted with Claude Code.)
